crop.notes: Clipping is the 'Sporting Notes' item; two East St. Louis Turf Exchange notices precede the Allen notice.

title.suggested: Notice of Free Concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and the latest songs of the day.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 4, 1891, page 7.

facts.fact: In July 1891 Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert every evening with the latest songs; he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Item is a three-line paid notice about Allen's place; focus primary because the item is entirely about him, though 'passing' is defensible.
